question: Run annotation on all recorded episodes and summarize.
ground_truth: This README Quick Run prompt grades every episode of the latest recorded HDF5 with uv run --project tools/annotator i4h-annotator ... offline <recording> --write, using the scene manifest's annotate block or the policy task prompt as the criterion and the caller-provided vision endpoint, then summarizes the verdicts.
expected_behavior: uses every episode of the latest recorded HDF5
takes the criterion, cameras, and judge from the scene manifest's annotate block, or from the policy task manifest's prompt when the scene has none, unless the user overrides it
uses a configured caller-provided vision endpoint and model instead of starting the local VLM
passes global options before the offline subcommand and does not require a success to complete
summarizes success labels and graded versus reused counts after annotation

question: Run the VLM annotator on my scissor pick-and-place recording and label which episodes satisfy the task.
ground_truth: This prompt grades a scissor_pick_and_place recording with i4h-annotator offline --write against a placement criterion from the scissor_pick_and_place task prompt, judged on the terminal state, and writes vlm_success labels per episode.
expected_behavior: phrases the criterion as the scissors reaching and remaining in the tray
labels every episode against the task criterion with --write
does not run annotation when only conversion or replay is requested
